engine.contract: E2-reading: slow TTS + ambient bed + one scene per passage

pitch: Bedtime stories read by Mommy. Honey, time for bed.

style.manner: warm lamplight, nursery calm, zero stimulation

voice.bed: soft room tone + distant lullaby mobile

mommy.direction: warm maternal voice, patient and smiling, close and unhurried, honey-time-for-bed
mommy.label: Mommy 208k uses (crown jewel)
mommy.lock_reason: owner pick: warmer mommy read than the 208k crown jewel

thesis: One voice, one ritual: honey-time-for-bed. Comfort originals + retold tales through a maternal persona; variety via seasons, winners get more.
audience: Adults seeking comfort listening (loneliness-adjacent), parents previewing for kids (not made for kids), ASMR-adjacent females 18-40.

sourcing.method: Reuse F&F tale library + company-comfort originals with mom-framing intros; never re-record without new framing
sourcing.pi_job: pick tales that survive maternal framing (kind endings); draft 2-line mom intros; flag scary tales out
